artifacts.description: Happy July! Can y'all do me a solid and help me rebuild my Instagram following? Last year I got hacked and lost all of my 100K followers. I'm just out here trying to share my music and catch you at an upcoming show (fall tour on sale now!) Please follow me over at my new account @hunterrootofficial and share with your friends. Can't thank you enough for all your support!

artifacts.description: The early stages of a new one. Nothing helps me more mentally than putting how I feel into song. Since getting my IG h*cked last week I've been a little down in the dumps. Bless this universe for giving us music.

artifacts.title: Guitar Lessons
artifacts.description:
Thanks to the folks who've reached out about getting guitar lessons from me! 🙏 The ball is actually rolling now so definitely message me if you're interested!
The next musical thing on the list is to release this single. It features my first guest musician I've ever had on my solo project, the one and only Robin Chambers on violin! Keep your eyes peeled for a release date. 🌠

artifacts.description:
hunterrootofficial
 
80w
Hey y'all! I just wanted to pop in and say we've been on the road the last couple weeks so I haven't been posting as much. Apologies! Will get back on that grind ASAP. I will also say I've also been busy recording a new song and cannot wait to share it soon! 😁 Much love to everyone who's been out to a show on this run. We got more dates, check hunterroot.com/shows for tix. 🎟️ @bearsvilletheater tonight in New York.✌️
.
.

gallery.title: Stage setup at Harrisburg venue with instruments and gear before performance
gallery.description: Empty stage at a Harrisburg, Pennsylvania venue on October 10, 2025, showing a complete band setup with drum kit branded 'Hunter Root', guitars, bass, keyboard, amplifiers, and monitors arranged on patterned rugs. Red curtain backdrop and stage lighting create an intimate performance atmosphere in what appears to be a small to mid-sized venue.

gallery.title: Hunter Root drum kit and stage setup at Harrisburg, Pennsylvania venue
gallery.description: Full stage setup for Hunter Root at a Harrisburg, Pennsylvania venue, featuring a red drum kit with custom "Hunter Root" logo on the bass drum head, flanked by amplifiers and a red hollow-body electric guitar. The professional stage arrangement is set against deep red curtains, ready for performance.

gallery.title: Hunter Root band performing live on stage in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania
gallery.description: Live performance photo from Harrisburg, Pennsylvania showing Hunter Root band on stage with drum kit displaying 'Hunter Root' logo. The stage setup includes amplifiers, pedal boards, and oriental-style rugs. Blue stage lights illuminate the venue backdrop as band members perform energetically.

gallery.title: Hunter Root band performing live on stage in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania
gallery.description: Live performance photo showing Hunter Root band on stage in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. Three musicians are visible with the drummer behind a kit displaying the Hunter Root logo, while two other members work with instruments and equipment. The stage features colorful floral-patterned rugs and various guitar pedals in the foreground.

gallery.title: Hunter Root performing solo acoustic set in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania
gallery.description: Hunter Root seated on stage performing solo with acoustic guitar in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. The stage features dramatic blue, yellow, and pink lighting with pedals and equipment arranged at his feet. The intimate venue setup captures a typical solo performance configuration.

gallery.title: Hunter Root performing solo with acoustic guitar on stage in Harrisburg, PA
gallery.description: Hunter Root performs solo acoustic on stage in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania, bathed in blue stage lighting. He sits on a stool with an acoustic guitar, surrounded by various pedals and equipment at his feet. The intimate performance setup features dramatic blue lighting and visible stage monitors.

gallery.title: Hunter Root performing acoustic solo set in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania
gallery.description: Hunter Root sits on a stool performing an intimate acoustic guitar set in Harrisburg, Pennsylvania. The stage is bathed in blue atmospheric lighting with LED stage lights visible overhead. His pedalboard and various effects pedals are visible on the floor in front of him, with another musician partially visible on the right side of the stage.

gallery.title: Hunter Root acoustic performance with bassist, filmed at venue near Hershey PA
gallery.description: Live performance setup showing acoustic guitarist and bassist performing on stage with dramatic blue and white lighting. The drum kit displays 'Hunter Root' branding, and a camera on tripod is capturing the performance. Photo taken near Hershey, Pennsylvania.

gallery.title: Hunter Root live performance at venue in Muhlenberg Township, PA
gallery.description: Live performance photo showing two musicians on stage in Muhlenberg Township, PA (near Reading). Acoustic guitarist/vocalist on left with long blonde hair, bassist on right with long hair and striped shirt. Professional stage lighting with blue and white beams, drum kit visible in background with "Hunter Root" logo. Camera equipment visible in foreground capturing the performance.

gallery.title: Hunter Root live performance with bassist, professional camera recording setup
gallery.description: Hunter Root performing acoustic guitar and vocals with a bassist (likely Nick Root) in a striped shirt on stage. Professional camera on tripod capturing the performance. Drum kit with Hunter Root logo visible in background with dramatic blue and white stage lighting.

gallery.title: Hunter Root with two friends at a venue in Lancaster, PA area
gallery.description: Hunter Root (center) poses with two friends at what appears to be a performance venue near Lancaster, Pennsylvania. The intimate venue setting features exposed ceiling beams, stage lighting, and a curtained stage area. Photo taken in the Lancaster area based on GPS coordinates.
